area.description: Area is the actionable defect area within the reviewed candidate.

severity.description: Severity is the finding severity label.

title.description: Title is the short human-readable title of the finding.

details.description: Details is the full review finding explanation.

locations.description: Locations optionally lists lightweight repo-relative source anchors for the finding, such as "path/to/file.go", "path/to/file.go#L123", or "path/to/file.go#L1-L3".

ReviewFinding.description: ReviewFinding is one review finding in a submission or aggregate.

ReviewFindingResolution.description: ReviewFindingResolution records whether one referenced finding is closed.

round_id.description: RoundID is the stable identifier for the review round.

slot.description: Slot is the stable slot identifier.

role.description: Role is the assignment role copied from the round manifest.

by.description: By is the reviewer-provided identity label for the submitted slot.

summary.description: Summary is the reviewer's concise overall assessment.

findings.description: Findings lists the review findings for the slot.

ReviewSubmission.description: ReviewSubmission is the command-owned submission artifact for one reviewer slot.
